description: Regression inventory from DESKTOP-REVIEW.md. Each scenario is assigned to the phase that adds its executable boundary coverage.

scenarios.outcome: Corrections, review state, images, captions, and document edits survive reload.
A saves independently while B continues to capture.
An untouched open document accepts native-generated notes; concurrent writing is retained.
Late save or generation callbacks cannot resurrect a deleted meeting.
Startup, stop, and repeated sessions leave no duplicate capture resources.
Partial resources are cleaned up and interrupted meetings remain recoverable.
Deferred termination preserves final transcript text and a durable meeting.
A callback from an old startup or session cannot alter a newer or stopped session.
Production requires the native bridge while explicit test hosts remain available.
The desktop library starts native capture and all caption controls share native state.
Automatic composition retains each image, respects manual writing, and only uses supported transcript context.
Finished-meeting imports can remain unanchored without a fabricated 0:00 source.
The primary document is usable while export and deletion report actual success, cancellation, or failure.
Synthetic long meetings and libraries measure payloads, latency, and retained memory.
Real audio, displays, sharing, accessibility, signing, and installer behavior are measured separately from unit tests.
